title: Guardian Angel, 2 dollars

specs.Decoration: digital printing, capsule with a silver filigree element covered with 24-karat gold plating, microprinting

descriptionPlain: Description The most beautiful gifts are those that offer a sense of safety. The “Guardian Angel” coin is more than silver. It is a personal talisman of care. Its subtle, luminous composition brings a feeling of calm and harmony at just a glance. At the heart of the design, beneath the transparent surface of the capsule, lies a radiant detail plated with 24-karat gold. Gift it to someone special as a keepsake that will accompany them on every path, offering strength and a gentle reminder to follow their intuition.
